ayahs.textUthmani: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ‌ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَتٰٓي اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْهُؕ سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The command of Allāh is coming,[690] so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: Ataa amrullaahi falaa tasta'jiloohu subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

footnotes.690: Literally, "has come," indicating the certainty and nearness of the Last Hour.

ayahs.translationClear: The command of Allah has come, so do not rush it. Glory be to Him; exalted above what they associate.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةَ بِالرُّوْحِ مِنْ اَمْرِهٖ عَلٰي مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖٓ اَنْ اَنْذِرُوْٓا اَنَّهٗ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنَا فَاتَّقُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
ayahs.transliteration: Yunazzilul-malaa'ikata bir-roohi min amrihee 'alaa man yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee an andhiroo annahoo laa ilaaha illaa ana fattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: He sends down the angels with the Spirit by His command, upon whom He wills of His servants: “Give warning that there is no god but Me, and fear Me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ‌ۚ تَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّؕ تَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi ta'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: He created the heavens and the earth with justice. He is exalted above the associations they attribute.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيْمٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once[691] he is a clear adversary.
ayahs.transliteration: Khalaqal-insaana min nutfatin fa'idhaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

footnotes.691: As soon as he becomes strong and independent.

ayahs.translationClear: He created the human being from a drop of fluid, yet he becomes an open adversary.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ خَلَقَهَا‌ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْاَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَاۚ لَكُمْ فِيْهَا دِفْءٌ وَّمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَ ࣕ
ayahs.translation: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth[692] and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-an'aama khalaqahaa lakum feehaa dif'un wamanaafi'u waminhaa ta'kuloon

footnotes.692: i.e., in clothing, tents, furnishings, etc.

ayahs.translationClear: And the livestock—He created them for you. In them are warmth and benefits for you, and of them you eat.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا جَمَالٌ حِيْنَ تُرِيْحُوْنَ وَحِيْنَ تَسْرَحُوْنَ ࣕ
ayahs.translation: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
ayahs.transliteration: Walakum feehaa jamaalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
ayahs.translationClear: And there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home, and when you drive them to pasture.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَـٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَـٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ‌ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَحْمِلُ اَثْقَالَكُمْ اِلٰي بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُوْنُوْا بٰلِغِيْهِ اِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْاَنْفُسِؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Watahmilu athqaalakum ilaa baladil lam takoonoo baaligheehi illaa bishiqqil-anfusi inna rabbakum lara'oofur raheem
ayahs.translationClear: And they carry your loads to territory you could not have reached without great hardship. Your Lord is Clement and Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً‌ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيْرَ لِتَرْكَبُوْهَا وَزِيْنَةًؕ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-khayla wal-bighaala wal-hameera litarkaboohaa wazeenatan wayakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: And the horses, and the mules, and the donkeys—for you to ride, and for luxury. And He creates what you do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ‌ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعَلَي اللّٰهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيْلِ وَمِنْهَا جَا࢜ىِٕرٌؕ وَلَوْ شَا࢜ءَ لَهَدٰىكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ࣖ

words.translation: surely He would have guided you

ayahs.translation: And upon Allāh[693] is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'alallaahi qasdus-sabeeli waminhaa jaa'irun walaw shaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een

footnotes.693: Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has taken it upon Himself to guide man to the right path. The meaning has also been interpreted as "To Allāh..."

ayahs.translationClear: It is for Allah to point out the paths, but some of them are flawed. Had He willed, He could have guided you all.

ayahs.textUthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً‌ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً لَّكُمْ مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَّمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيْهِ تُسِيْمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'al lakum minhu sharaabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who sends down for you from the sky water. From it is drink, and with it grows vegetation for grazing.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: يُنۢ͏ْبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُوْنَ وَالنَّخِيْلَ وَالْاَعْنَابَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and of all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: Yumbitu lakum bihiz-zar'a waz-zaytoona wan-nakheela wal-a'naaba wamin kullith-thamaraati inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmin yatafakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: And He produces for you grains with it, and olives, and date-palms, and grapes, and all kinds of fruits. Surely in that is a sign for people who think.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ‌ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَۙ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَؕ وَالنُّجُوْمُ مُسَخَّرٰتٌۢ بِاَمْرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.transliteration: Wasakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamara wan-nujoomu musakhkharaatum bi'amrihee inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmin ya'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: And He regulated for you the night and the day; and the sun, and the moon, and the stars are disposed by His command. Surely in that are signs for people who ponder.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا ذَرَاَ لَكُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَانُهٗؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّذَّكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa dhara'a lakum fil-ardi mukhtalifan alwaanuhoo inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmin yadhdhakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: And whatsoever He created for you on earth is of diverse colors. Surely in that is a sign for people who are mindful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَاْكُلُوْا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَّتَسْتَخْرِجُوْا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُوْنَهَاۚ وَتَرَي الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيْهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee sakhkharal-bahra lita'kuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonahaa wataral-fulka mawaakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: And it is He who made the sea to serve you, that you may eat from it tender meat, and extract from it ornaments that you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, as you seek His bounties, so that you may give thanks.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَـٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَـٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَلْقٰي فِي الْاَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنْ تَمِيْدَ بِكُمْ وَاَنْهٰرًا وَّسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa'anhaaran wasubulal la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: And He cast mountains on the earth, lest it shifts with you; and rivers, and roads, so that you may be guided.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعَلَـٰمَـٰتٍ ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعَلَـٰمَـٰتٍ‌ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعَلٰمٰتٍؕ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.[694]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'alaamaatin wabin-najmi hum yahtadoon

footnotes.694: Through the desert or the sea at night.

ayahs.translationClear: And landmarks. And by the stars they guide themselves.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ‌ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَمَنْ يَّخْلُقُ كَمَنْ لَّا يَخْلُقُؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
ayahs.transliteration: Afaman yakhluqu kamal laa yakhluqu afalaa tadhakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: Is He who creates like him who does not create? Will you not take a lesson?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ‌ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ تَعُدُّوْا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحْصُوْهَاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And if you should count the favors of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in ta'uddoo ni'matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa innallaaha laghafoorur raheem
ayahs.translationClear: And if you tried to enumerate the favors of Allah, you will not be able to count them. Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you declare.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoon
ayahs.translationClear: And Allah knows what you hide and what you disclose.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَخْلُقُوْنَ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّهُمْ يُخْلَقُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And those they invoke other than Allāh create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi laa yakhluqoona shay'an wahum yukhlaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: Those they invoke besides Allah create nothing, but are themselves created.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ‌ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ اَحْيَا࢜ءٍۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَۙ اَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: They are [in fact] dead,[695] not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
ayahs.transliteration: Amwaatun ghayru ahyaa'in wamaa yash'uroona ayyaana yub'athoon
ayahs.translationClear: They are dead, not alive; and they do not know when they will be resurrected.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ‌ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْ مُّنْكِرَةٌ وَّهُمْ مُّسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
ayahs.transliteration: Ilaahukum ilaahun waahidun fal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Your god is One God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are arrogant.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Assuredly, Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa jarama annallaaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoona innahoo laa yuhibbul-mustakbireen
ayahs.translationClear: Without a doubt, Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not like the arrogant.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ‌ۙ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ مَّاذَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْۙ قَالُوْٓا اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" they say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum maadhaa anzala rabbukum qaaloo asaateerul-awwaleen
ayahs.translationClear: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Legends of the ancients.”

ayahs.textUthmani: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ‌ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لِيَحْمِلُوْٓا اَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَّوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِۙ وَمِنْ اَوْزَارِ الَّذِيْنَ يُضِلُّوْنَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍؕ اَلَا سَا࢜ءَ مَا يَزِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: That they may bear their own burdens [i.e., sins] in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without [i.e., by lack of] knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyahmiloo awzaarahum kaamilatan yawmal-qiyaamati wamin awzaaril-ladheena yudilloonahum bighayri 'ilmin alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
ayahs.translationClear: So let them carry their loads complete on the Day of Resurrection, and some of the loads of those they misguided without knowledge. Evil is what they carry.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَـٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَـٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَاَتَي اللّٰهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَاَتٰىهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those before them had already plotted, but Allāh came at [i.e., uprooted] their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them,[696] and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.transliteration: Qad makaral-ladheena min qablihim fa'atallaahu bunyaanahum minal-qawaa'idi fakharra 'alayhimus-saqfu min fawqihim wa'ataahumul-'adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon

footnotes.696: i.e., Allāh caused their plan to fail and exposed their plot.

ayahs.translationClear: Those before them also schemed, but Allah took their structures from the foundations, and the roof caved in on them. The punishment came at them from where they did not perceive.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَـٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَـٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ‌ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يُخْزِيْهِمْ وَيَقُوْلُ اَيْنَ شُرَكَا࢜ءِيَ الَّذِيْنَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَا࢜قُّوْنَ فِيْهِمْؕ قَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ اِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوْ࢜ءَ عَلَي الْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum tushaaqqoona feehim qaalal-ladheena ootul-'ilma innal-khizyal-yawma was-soo'a 'alal-kaafireen
ayahs.translationClear: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them, and say, “Where are My associates for whose sake you used to dispute?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Today shame and misery are upon the disbelievers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ‌ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ‌ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ تَتَوَفّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ ظَالِمِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْࣕ فَاَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِنْ سُوْ࢜ءٍؕ بَلٰٓي اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves,[697] and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu zaalimee anfusihim fa'alqawus-salama maa kunnaa na'malu min soo'im balaa innallaaha 'aleemum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

footnotes.697: i.e., having made punishment due to them for their numerous sins and crimes.

ayahs.translationClear: Those wronging their souls while the angels are taking them away—they will propose peace: “We did no wrong.” Yes you did. Allah is aware of what you used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا‌ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَادْخُلُوْٓا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَاؕ فَلَبِي͏ٔ͏ْسَ مَثْوَي الْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
ayahs.transliteration: Fadkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa falabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
ayahs.translationClear: Enter the gates of Hell, to dwell therein forever. Miserable is the residence of the arrogant.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ‌ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًا‌ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ‌ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ‌ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقِيْلَ لِلَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْؕ قَالُوْا خَيْرًاؕ لِلَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا فِيْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌؕ وَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةِ خَيْرٌؕ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And it will be said to those who feared Allāh, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
ayahs.transliteration: Waqeela lilladheenattaqaw maadhaa anzala rabbukum qaaloo khayral lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanatun waladaarul-aakhirati khayrun walani'ma daarul-muttaqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And it will be said to those who maintained piety, “What has your Lord revealed?” They will say, “Goodness.” To those who do good in this world is goodness, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better. How wonderful is the residence of the pious.

ayahs.textUthmani: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ‌ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَّدْخُلُوْنَهَا تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ لَهُمْ فِيْهَا مَا يَشَا࢜ءُوْنَؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَجْزِي اللّٰهُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allāh reward the righteous -
ayahs.transliteration: Jannaatu 'adnin yadkhuloonahaa tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona kadhaalika yajzillaahul-muttaqeen
ayahs.translationClear: The Gardens of Perpetuity, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow, where they will have whatever they desire. Thus Allah rewards the pious.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ‌ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ تَتَوَفّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ طَيِّبِيْنَۙ يَقُوْلُوْنَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُۙ ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salaamun 'alaykumudkhulul-jannata bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: Those who are in a wholesome state when the angels take them—will say, “Peace be upon you; enter Paradise, for what you used to do.”

ayahs.textUthmani: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ‌ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنْ تَاْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ اَوْ يَاْتِيَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَؕ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they [i.e., the disbelievers] await except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allāh wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya amru rabbika kadhaalika fa'alal-ladheena min qablihim wamaa zalamahumullaahu walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Are they but waiting for the angels to come to them, or for the command of your Lord to arrive? Those before them did likewise. Allah did not wrong them, but they used to wrong their own souls.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa 'amiloo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.translationClear: So the evils of their deeds assailed them, and what they used to ridicule engulfed them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ‌ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْا لَوْ شَا࢜ءَ اللّٰهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ شَيْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَا͏ٓ اٰبَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ شَيْءٍؕ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْۚ فَهَلْ عَلَي الرُّسُلِ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.translation: And those who associate others with Allāh say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'allaahu maa 'abadnaa min doonihee min shay'in nahnu walaa aabaa'unaa walaa harramnaa min doonihee min shay'in kadhaalika fa'alal-ladheena min qablihim fahal 'alar-rusuli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: The idolaters say, “Had Allah willed, we would not have worshiped anything besides Him, neither us, nor our ancestors, nor would we have prohibited anything besides His prohibitions.” Those before them did likewise. Are the messengers responsible for anything but clear communication?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ‌ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةُ‌ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِيْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوْلًا اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوْتَۚ فَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ هَدَي اللّٰهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلٰلَةُؕ فَسِيْرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allāh and avoid ṭāghūt."[698] And among them were those whom Allāh guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed [i.e., travel] through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad ba'athnaa fee kulli ummatir rasoolan ani'budullaaha wajtanibut-taaghoota faminhum man hadallaahu waminhum man haqqat 'alayhid-dalaalatu faseeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
ayahs.translationClear: To every community We sent a messenger: “Worship Allah, and avoid idolatry.” Some of them Allah guided, while others deserved misguidance. So travel through the earth, and see what the fate of the deniers was.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ‌ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنْ تَحْرِصْ عَلٰي هُدٰىهُمْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِيْ مَنْ يُّضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muḥammad], indeed, Allāh does not guide those He sends astray,[699] and they will have no helpers.
ayahs.transliteration: In tahris 'alaa hudaahum fa'innallaaha laa yahdee man yudillu wamaa lahum min naasireen

footnotes.699: As a result of their choice to reject guidance.

ayahs.translationClear: Even though you may be concerned about their guidance, Allah does not guide those who misguide. And they will have no saviors.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ‌ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ‌ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَقْسَمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ اللّٰهُ مَنْ يَّمُوْتُؕ بَلٰي وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths [that] Allāh will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim laa yab'athullaahu man yamootu balaa wa'dan 'alayhi haqqan walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: And they swear by Allah with their most solemn oaths, “Allah will not resurrect anyone who dies.” Yes indeed, it is a promise binding on Him, but most people do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَـٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَـٰذِبِينَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِيْ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ فِيْهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا كٰذِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyubayyina lahumul-ladhee yakhtalifoona feehi waliya'lamal-ladheena kafaroo annahum kaanoo kaadhibeen
ayahs.translationClear: To clarify for them what they differed about, and for the faithless to know that they were liars.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَـٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَـٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ اِذَا͏ٓ اَرَدْنٰهُ اَنْ نَّقُوْلَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa qawlunaa lishay'in idhaa aradnaahu an naqoola lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.translationClear: When We intend for something to happen, We say to it, “Be,” and it becomes.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً‌ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ‌ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوْا فِي اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْا لَنُبَوِّي͏ٔ͏َنَّهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًؕ وَلَاَجْرُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ

words.translation: surely We will give them position

ayahs.translation: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allāh after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-ladheena haajaroo fillaahi mim ba'di maa zulimoo lanubawwi'annahum fid-dunyaa hasanatan wala'ajrul-aakhirati akbaru law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Those who emigrate for Allah’s sake after being persecuted, We will settle them in a good place in this world; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ صَبَرُوْا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena sabaroo wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
ayahs.translationClear: Those who endure patiently, and in their Lord they put their trust.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ‌ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـٔ͏َلُوْٓا اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim fas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: We did not send before you except men whom We inspired. So ask the people of knowledge, if you do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ‌ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِؕ وَاَنْزَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: Bil-bayyinaati waz-zuburi wa'anzalnaa ilaykadh-dhikra litubayyina linnaasi maa nuzzila ilayhim wala'allahum yatafakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: With the clarifications and the scriptures. And We revealed to you the Reminder, that you may clarify to the people what was revealed to them, and that they may reflect.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَاَمِنَ الَّذِيْنَ مَكَرُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنْ يَّخْسِفَ اللّٰهُ بِهِمُ الْاَرْضَ اَوْ يَاْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allāh will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
ayahs.transliteration: Afa'aminal-ladheena makarus-sayyi'aati an yakhsifallaahu bihimul-arda aw ya'tiyahumul-'adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
ayahs.translationClear: Do those who scheme evils feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to cave in with them, or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ يَاْخُذَهُمْ فِيْ تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure [i.e., escape from Him]?
ayahs.transliteration: Aw ya'khudhahum fee taqallubihim famaa hum bimu'jizeen
ayahs.translationClear: Or that He will not seize them during their activities? And they will not be able to prevent it.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ يَاْخُذَهُمْ عَلٰي تَخَوُّفٍؕ فَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]?[700] But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.[701]
ayahs.transliteration: Aw ya'khudhahum 'alaa takhawwufin fa'inna rabbakum lara'oofur raheem

footnotes.700: i.e., being aware of what is about to strike them after having seen those near them succumb.
footnotes.701: Postponing deserved punishment and giving opportunities for repentance.

ayahs.translationClear: Or that He will not seize them while in dread? Your Lord is Gentle and Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَـٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَـٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلٰي مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَّتَفَيَّو͏ٔ͏ُا ظِلٰلُهٗ عَنِ الْيَمِيْنِ وَالشَّمَا࢜ىِٕلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلّٰهِ وَهُمْ دٰخِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have they not considered what things Allāh has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allāh, while they [i.e., those creations] are humble.
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilaa maa khalaqallaahu min shay'in yatafayya'u zilaaluhoo 'anil-yameeni wash-shamaa'ili sujjadal lillaahi wahum daakhiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not observed what Allah has created? Their shadows revolve from the right and the left, bowing to Allah as they shrink away.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِلّٰهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِ مِنْ دَا࢜بَّةٍ وَّالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
ayahs.transliteration: Walillaahi yasjudu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi min daabbatin wal-malaa'ikatu wahum laa yastakbiroon
ayahs.translationClear: To Allah bows down everything in the heavens and everything on earth—every living creature, and the angels, and without being proud.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: يَخَافُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُوْنَ مَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمَرُوْنَ ࣛࣖ
ayahs.translation: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
ayahs.transliteration: Yakhaafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
ayahs.translationClear: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَـٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَـٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ‌ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ‌ۖ فَإِيَّـٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ اللّٰهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوْٓا اِلٰهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِۚ اِنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَاِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has said, "Do not take for yourselves two[702] deities. He [i.e., Allāh] is but one God, so fear only Me."
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalallaahu laa tattakhidhoo ilaahaynithnayni innamaa huwa ilaahun waahidun fa'iyyaaya farhaboon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah has said: “Do not take two gods; He is only One God; so fear only Me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا‌ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّيْنُ وَاصِبًاؕ اَفَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allāh that you fear?
ayahs.transliteration: Walahoo maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi walahud-deenu waasiban afaghayrallaahi tattaqoon
ayahs.translationClear: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and to Him obedience is due always. Do you, then, fear anyone other than Allah?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا بِكُمْ مِّنْ نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَاِلَيْهِ تَجْـٔ͏َرُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa bikum min ni'matin faminallaahi thumma idhaa massakumud-durru fa'ilayhi taj'aroon
ayahs.translationClear: Whatever blessing you have is from Allah. And when harm touches you, it is to Him that you groan.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ اِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنْكُمْ اِذَا فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْكُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma idhaa kashafad-durra 'ankum idhaa fareequm minkum birabbihim yushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: But when He lifts the harm from you, some of you associate others with their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ‌ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟‌ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لِيَكْفُرُوْا بِمَا͏ٓ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوْاࣞ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum fatamatta'oo fasawfa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Enjoy yourselves. You will soon know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ‌ۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَجْعَلُوْنَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ نَصِيْبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْؕ تَاللّٰهِ لَتُسْـٔ͏َلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they assign to what they do not know[703] [i.e., false deities] a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allāh, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaj'aloona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseebam mimmaa razaqnaahum tallaahi latus'alunna 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon

footnotes.703: i.e., that of which they have no knowledge; rather, they have mere assumption based upon tradition or the claims of misguided men.

ayahs.translationClear: And they allocate, to something they do not know, a share of what We have provided for them. By Allah, you will be questioned about what you have been inventing.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَـٰتِ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَـٰتِ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ‌ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَجْعَلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ الْبَنٰتِ سُبْحٰنَهٗۙ وَلَهُمْ مَّا يَشْتَهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they attribute to Allāh daughters[704] - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire [i.e., sons].
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaj'aloona lillaahil-banaati subhaanahoo walahum maa yashtahoon

footnotes.704: By claiming that the angels are His daughters.

ayahs.translationClear: And they attribute to Allah daughters—exalted is He—and for themselves what they desire.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمْ بِالْاُنْثٰي ظَلَّ وَجْهُهٗ مُسْوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيْمٌ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa bushshira ahaduhum bil-unthaa zalla wajhuhoo muswaddan wahuwa kazeem
ayahs.translationClear: And when one of them is given news of a female infant, his face darkens, and he chokes with grief.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ‌ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ‌ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: يَتَوَارٰي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوْ࢜ءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهٖؕ اَيُمْسِكُهٗ عَلٰي هُوْنٍ اَمْ يَدُسُّهٗ فِي التُّرَابِؕ اَلَا سَا࢜ءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ

words.translation: he has been given good news

ayahs.translation: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.
ayahs.transliteration: Yatawaaraa minal-qawmi min soo'i maa bushshira bihee ayumsikuhoo 'alaa hoonin am yadussuhoo fit-turaabi alaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
ayahs.translationClear: He hides from the people because of the bad news given to him. Shall he keep it in humiliation, or bury it in the dust? Evil is the decision they make.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ‌ۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: لِلَّذِيْنَ لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِۚ وَلِلّٰهِ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰيؕ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description [i.e., an attribute] of evil;[705] and for Allāh is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Lilladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati mathalus-saw'i walillaahil-mathalul-a'laa wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem

footnotes.705: Such as that described in the previous two verses.

ayahs.translationClear: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter set a bad example, while Allah sets the Highest Example. He is the Mighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةً‌ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ يُو͏ٔ͏َاخِذُ اللّٰهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِمْ مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ دَا࢜بَّةٍ وَّلٰكِنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏َخِّرُهُمْ اِلٰٓي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيۚ فَاِذَا جَا࢜ءَ اَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَ سَاعَةً وَّلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw yu'aakhidhullaahun-naasa bizulmihim maa taraka 'alayhaa min daabbatin walaakin yu'akhkhiruhum ilaa ajalim musamman fa'idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum laa yasta'khiroona saa'atan walaa yastaqdimoon
ayahs.translationClear: If Allah were to hold mankind for their injustices, He would not leave upon it a single creature, but He postpones them until an appointed time. Then, when their time arrives, they will not delay it by one hour, nor will they advance it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ‌ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَجْعَلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ مَا يَكْرَهُوْنَ وَتَصِفُ اَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنٰيؕ لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَاَنَّهُمْ مُّفْرَطُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they attribute to Allāh that which they dislike [i.e., daughters], and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.[706]
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaj'aloona lillaahi maa yakrahoona watasifu alsinatuhumul-kadhiba anna lahumul-husnaa laa jarama anna lahumun-naara wa'annahum mufratoon

footnotes.706: Another meaning is "...and they will be made to precede [all others thereto]."

ayahs.translationClear: And they attribute to Allah what they themselves dislike, while their tongues utter the lie that theirs is the goodness. Without a doubt, for them is the Fire, and they will be neglected.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰٓي اُمَمٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: By Allāh, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is their [i.e., the disbelievers] ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Tallaahi laqad arsalnaa ilaa umamim min qablika fazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul-yawma walahum 'adhaabun aleem
ayahs.translationClear: By Allah, We sent messengers to communities before you, but Satan made their deeds appear alluring to them. He is their master today, and they will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ‌ۙ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوْا فِيْهِۙ وَهُدًي وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa anzalnaa 'alaykal-kitaaba illaa litubayyina lahumul-ladhikhtalafoo feehi wahudan warahmatal liqawmin yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: We revealed to you the Scripture only to clarify for them what they differ about, and guidance and mercy for people who believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّسْمَعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmin yasma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah sends down water from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death. In this is a sign for people who listen.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً‌ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّ لَكُمْ فِي الْاَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةًؕ نُسْقِيْكُمْ مِّمَّا فِيْ بُطُوْنِهٖ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَّدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَا࢜ىِٕغًا لِّلشّٰرِبِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'inna lakum fil-an'aami la'ibratan nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihee mim bayni farthin wadamil labanan khaalisan saa'ighal lishshaaribeen
ayahs.translationClear: And there is a lesson for you in cattle: We give you a drink from their bellies, from between waste and blood, pure milk, refreshing to the drinkers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ ثَمَرٰتِ النَّخِيْلِ وَالْاَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُوْنَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَّرِزْقًا حَسَنًاؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision.[707] Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin thamaraatin-nakheeli wal-a'naabi tattakhidhoona minhu sakaran warizqan hasanan inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmin ya'qiloon

footnotes.707: This verse was revealed before the prohibition of intoxicants. It alludes to the fact that there are both evil and good possibilities in certain things.

ayahs.translationClear: And from the fruits of date-palms and grapevines, you derive sugar and wholesome food. In this is a sign for people who understand.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَوْحٰي رَبُّكَ اِلَي النَّحْلِ اَنِ اتَّخِذِيْ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوْتًا وَّمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses [i.e., hives], and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'awhaa rabbuka ilan-nahli anittakhidhee minal-jibaali buyootan waminash-shajari wamimmaa ya'rishoon
ayahs.translationClear: And your Lord inspired the bee: “Set up hives in the mountains, and in the trees, and in what they construct.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا‌ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ كُلِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ فَاسْلُكِيْ سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًاؕ يَخْرُجُ مِنْۢ بُطُوْنِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ اَلْوَانُهٗ فِيْهِ شِفَا࢜ءٌ لِّلنَّاسِؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then eat from all the fruits[708] and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma kulee min kullith-thamaraati faslukee subula rabbiki dhululan yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaabum mukhtalifun alwaanuhoo feehi shifaa'ul linnaasi inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmin yatafakkaroon

footnotes.708: i.e., delicious substances found by the bee.

ayahs.translationClear: “Then eat of all the fruits, and go along the pathways of your Lord, with precision.” From their bellies emerges a fluid of diverse colors, containing healing for the people. Surely in this is a sign for people who reflect.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ‌ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔا‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْࣞۙ وَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّرَدُّ اِلٰٓي اَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـٔ͏ًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌ قَدِيْرٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffaakum waminkum man yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-'umuri likay laa ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shay'an innallaaha 'aleemun qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Allah created you; then He takes you away. Some of you will be brought back to the worst age, so that he will no longer know anything, after having acquired knowledge. Allah is Omniscient and Omnipotent.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ‌ۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ‌ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلٰي بَعْضٍ فِي الرِّزْقِۚ فَمَا الَّذِيْنَ فُضِّلُوْا بِرَا࢜دِّيْ رِزْقِهِمْ عَلٰي مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيْهِ سَوَا࢜ءٌؕ اَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored [i.e., given more] would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess [i.e., slaves] so they would be equal to them therein.[709] Then is it the favor of Allāh they reject?
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu faddala ba'dakum 'alaa ba'din fir-rizqi famal-ladheena fuddiloo biraaddee rizqihim 'alaa maa malakat aymaanuhum fahum feehi sawaa'un afabini'matillaahi yajhadoon

footnotes.709: The argument presented in this verse is that if they cannot consider their own possessions equal to themselves, then how can they consider Allāh's creations as being equal to Him?

ayahs.translationClear: Allah has favored some of you over others in livelihood. Those who are favored would not give their properties to their servants, to the extent of making them partners in it. Will they then renounce Allah’s blessings?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ‌ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَنِيْنَ وَحَفَدَةً وَّرَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِؕ اَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللّٰهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allāh they disbelieve?
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajan waja'ala lakum min azwaajikum baneena wahafadatan warazaqakum minat-tayyibaati afabil-baatili yu'minoona wabini'matillaahi hum yakfuroon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah has given you mates from among yourselves; and has produced for you, from your mates, children and grandchildren; and has provided you with good things. Will they then believe in falsehood, and refuse Allah’s favors?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ شَيْـٔ͏ًا وَّلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And they worship besides Allāh that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
ayahs.transliteration: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqam minas-samaawaati wal-ardi shay'an walaa yastatee'oon
ayahs.translationClear: And yet they serve besides Allah what possesses no provisions for them in the heavens, nor on earth, nor are they capable.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوْا لِلّٰهِ الْاَمْثَالَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So do not assert similarities to Allāh.[710] Indeed, Allāh knows and you do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa tadriboo lillaahil-amthaala innallaaha ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamoon

footnotes.710: As there is nothing comparable to Him.

ayahs.translationClear: So do not cite the examples for Allah. Allah knows, and you do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَـٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَـٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَجَهْرًا‌ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ‌ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ‌ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوْكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلٰي شَيْءٍ وَّمَنْ رَّزَقْنٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَّجَهْرًاؕ هَلْ يَسْتَوٗنَؕ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِؕ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allāh presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allāh! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Daraballaahu mathalan 'abdam mamlookal laa yaqdiru 'alaa shay'in wamar razaqnaahu minnaa rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawoonal-hamdu lillaahi bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah cites the example of a bonded slave, who has no power over anything; and someone to whom We have given plentiful provision, from which he gives secretly and openly. Are they equal in comparison? All praise belongs to Allah, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ‌ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ‌ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ اَحَدُهُمَا͏ٓ اَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلٰي شَيْءٍ وَّهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلٰي مَوْلٰىهُۙ اَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّهْهُّ لَا يَاْتِ بِخَيْرٍؕ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيْ هُوَۙ وَمَنْ يَّاْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِۙ وَهُوَ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
ayahs.transliteration: Wadaraballaahu mathalar rajulayni ahaduhumaa abkamu laa yaqdiru 'alaa shay'in wahuwa kallun 'alaa mawlaahu aynamaa yuwajjihhhu laa ya'ti bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa waman ya'muru bil-'adli wahuwa 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: And Allah cites the example of two men: one of them dumb, unable to do anything, and is a burden on his master; whichever way he directs him, he achieves nothing good. Is he equal to him who commands justice, and is on a straight path?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ وَمَا͏ٓ اَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ اِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ اَوْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: And to Allāh belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Walillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa amrus-saa'ati illaa kalamhil-basari aw huwa aqrabu innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: To Allah belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth. The coming of the Hour is only as the twinkling of the eye, or even nearer. Allah has power over everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ‌ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ اَخْرَجَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ شَيْـٔ͏ًاۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect] that perhaps you would be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu akhrajakum mim butooni ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shay'an waja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah brought you out of your mothers’ wombs, not knowing anything; and He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains; that you may give thanks.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ‌ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَي الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرٰتٍ فِيْ جَوِّ السَّمَا࢜ءِؕ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allāh. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Alam yaraw ilat-tayri musakhkharaatin fee jawwis-samaa'i maa yumsikuhunna illallaahu inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmin yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not seen the birds, flying in the midst of the sky? None sustains them except Allah. In this are signs for people who believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَـٰثًا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ بُيُوتًا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ‌ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَـٰثًا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُيُوْتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ جُلُوْدِ الْاَنْعَامِ بُيُوْتًا تَسْتَخِفُّوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ اِقَامَتِكُمْۙ وَمِنْ اَصْوَافِهَا وَاَوْبَارِهَا وَاَشْعَارِهَا͏ٓ اَثَاثًا وَّمَتَاعًا اِلٰي حِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mim buyootikum sakanan waja'ala lakum min juloodil-an'aami buyootan tastakhiffoonahaa yawma za'nikum wayawma iqaamatikum wamin aswaafihaa wa'awbaarihaa wa'ash'aarihaa athaathan wamataa'an ilaa heen
ayahs.translationClear: And Allah has given you in your homes habitats for you, and has provided for you out of the hides of livestock portable homes for you, so you can use them when you travel, and when you camp; and from their wool, and fur, and hair, furnishings and comfort for a while.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَـٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَـٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَـٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَـٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلٰلًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ اَكْنَانًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيْلَ تَقِيْكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيْلَ تَقِيْكُمْ بَاْسَكُمْؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهٗ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And Allāh has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows [i.e., shade] and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments [i.e., coats of mail] which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
ayahs.transliteration: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mimmaa khalaqa zilaalan waja'ala lakum minal-jibaali aknaanan waja'ala lakum saraabeela taqeekumul-harra wasaraabeela taqeekum ba'sakum kadhaalika yutimmu ni'matahoo 'alaykum la'allakum tuslimoon
ayahs.translationClear: And Allah has made for you shade out of what He has created, and has given you resorts in the mountains, and has given you garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you from your violence. Thus He completes His blessings upon you, so that you may submit.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away, [O Muḥammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa 'alaykal-balaaghul-mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: But if they turn away, your only duty is clear communication.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
